routines.semantics: Read flat interleaved ordinate/first-derivative pairs at first+i*step; infer n from exactly half the even array length. Return both {f,df} for degree at most 2n−1; df is measured against x, not node index. Preserve negative nonzero step and extrapolation. Inputs are finite and arrays readonly. routines.cleanup: Kernel-free inputs have no persistent fixture. Native owns input/output buffers under the existing global SPICE mutex; shared C checks pointers/counts, calls the exact canonical entrypoint and captures/resets SPICE errors. Focused comparisons scale small physical magnitudes back to observable units rather than increasing the shared tolerance. Tagged comparisons preserve full field/array structure, IEEE categories and zero signs with a relative-only finite comparison.
